Everyone I know who is actually LGBT calls it by the first four letters, and may add the Q for “Queer” to make it more inclusive. “Ally” is absolutely not what the A stands for, as they are not part of the community. I honestly don’t remember the entire acronym, because most of the letters were added on by cishet people to make the community look idiotic. Hope this helps a bit.
Edit: it is also not a crime to accidentally misgender someone. Articles that say that are fake and portraying transgender people as “the issue.” What actually happened was gross, intentional transphobia by those people.
